sentences.pt: Na sexta-feira, a prefeitura de Salvador fez um festival de música na praça.
sentences.en: On Friday, Salvador's city hall put on a music festival in the square.

sentences.pt: Juliana viu a notícia numa rede social e convidou as amigas.
sentences.en: Juliana saw the news on a social network and invited her friends.

sentences.pt: Os ingressos eram baratos: só vinte reais.
sentences.en: The tickets were cheap: only twenty reais.

sentences.pt: Ela comprou três ingressos na bilheteria do teatro.
sentences.en: She bought three tickets at the theater's box office.

sentences.pt: Na noite do show, a praça estava muito cheia.
sentences.en: On the night of the concert, the square was very crowded.

sentences.pt: Tinha gente de todas as idades: crianças, jovens e idosos.
sentences.en: There were people of all ages: children, young people and elderly people.

sentences.pt: No palco, uma banda famosa da Bahia começou a tocar samba.
sentences.en: On stage, a famous band from Bahia started playing samba.

sentences.pt: A cantora cantava muito bem e dançava ao mesmo tempo.
sentences.en: The singer sang very well and danced at the same time.

sentences.pt: Juliana e as amigas cantaram as músicas favoritas delas.
sentences.en: Juliana and her friends sang their favorite songs.

sentences.pt: Um senhor ao lado delas dançava com a esposa.
sentences.en: An older man next to them was dancing with his wife.

sentences.pt: "Eu conheço essa banda há trinta anos!", ele disse para Juliana.
sentences.en: "I've known this band for thirty years!" he told Juliana.

sentences.pt: Depois de uma hora, começou a garoar.
sentences.en: After an hour, it started to drizzle.

sentences.pt: Mas ninguém foi para casa.
sentences.en: But nobody went home.

sentences.pt: Todos continuaram dançando na chuva.
sentences.en: Everyone kept dancing in the rain.

sentences.pt: No fim, o cantor disse: "Muito obrigado, Salvador!"
sentences.en: At the end, the singer said: "Thank you very much, Salvador!"

sentences.pt: Depois do show, as amigas comeram um lanche e conversaram.
sentences.en: After the concert, the friends had a snack and chatted.

sentences.pt: "Foi o melhor show do ano", disse Juliana.
sentences.en: "It was the best concert of the year," said Juliana.

sentences.pt: "Com certeza!", responderam as amigas.
sentences.en: "Definitely!" answered her friends.

sentences.pt: Agora elas estão esperando o festival do ano que vem.
sentences.en: Now they're waiting for next year's festival.

questions.qEn: How much did the ticket cost?

questions.q: O que aconteceu depois de uma hora?

sentences.pt: Ricardo é torcedor de um time do Rio desde criança.
sentences.en: Ricardo has been a fan of a Rio team since he was a child.

sentences.pt: No domingo, o time dele ia jogar o último jogo do campeonato.
sentences.en: On Sunday, his team was going to play the last match of the championship.

sentences.pt: Ricardo convidou os amigos e o cunhado para assistir ao jogo em casa.
sentences.en: Ricardo invited his friends and his brother-in-law to watch the match at home.

sentences.pt: Ele comprou cerveja e refrigerante, e a esposa fez pão de queijo.
sentences.en: He bought beer and soda, and his wife made cheese bread.

sentences.pt: O filho dele, de oito anos, também estava com a camisa do time.
sentences.en: His eight-year-old son was also wearing the team shirt.

sentences.pt: O jogo começou às quatro horas da tarde.
sentences.en: The match started at four in the afternoon.

sentences.pt: Todos estavam sentados no sofá, ansiosos.
sentences.en: Everyone was sitting on the sofa, anxious.

sentences.pt: Depois de vinte minutos, o outro time estava ganhando por 1 a 0.
sentences.en: After twenty minutes, the other team was winning 1-0.

sentences.pt: Ricardo ficou bravo e reclamou muito.
sentences.en: Ricardo got angry and complained a lot.

sentences.pt: "Eles estão jogando muito mal!", ele disse.
sentences.en: "They're playing really badly!" he said.

sentences.pt: O cunhado riu: "Calma, o jogo ainda não acabou."
sentences.en: His brother-in-law laughed: "Calm down, the match isn't over yet."

sentences.pt: No segundo tempo, o time de Ricardo começou a jogar melhor.
sentences.en: In the second half, Ricardo's team started to play better.

sentences.pt: Aos trinta minutos, o jogo estava 1 a 1.
sentences.en: At thirty minutes, the match was 1-1.

sentences.pt: Todos pularam do sofá, muito felizes.
sentences.en: Everyone jumped up from the sofa, very happy.

sentences.pt: No último minuto, o jogo ficou 2 a 1 para o time de Ricardo.
sentences.en: In the last minute, the match became 2-1 to Ricardo's team.

sentences.pt: O time ganhou o campeonato!
sentences.en: The team won the championship!

sentences.pt: Ricardo e o filho dançaram na sala.
sentences.en: Ricardo and his son danced in the living room.

sentences.pt: Na rua, os vizinhos cantavam e tocavam música.
sentences.en: In the street, the neighbors were singing and playing music.

sentences.pt: "Esse foi o melhor domingo do ano!", disse o filho.
sentences.en: "That was the best Sunday of the year!" said his son.

sentences.pt: Ricardo concordou, quase chorando de alegria.
sentences.en: Ricardo agreed, almost crying with joy.

questions.qEn: Where did they watch the match?

questions.q: Quem disse "Calma, o jogo ainda não acabou"?
questions.qEn: Who said "Calm down, the match isn't over yet"?
